01
Vector illustration

Model S Plaid

Brief

Rebuild a photograph as a flat vector illustration without losing what makes the car recognizable.

Approach

Limited to three colors: green, yellow and teal, an analogous scheme. Every reflection and panel line is a flat shape in a tint or shade of one of the three, so light is described by shape alone.

Outcome

A print-ready illustration that holds up from a phone screen to a poster.

RoleIllustration
ToolsIllustrator
Year2026
ProgramA.W. Beattie, Advertising Design
02
Logo design

On the Rocks

Brief

Name a loaded-nacho food truck and design its primary mark.

Approach

One image carries everything: a chip melting on an open flame. Cracked, hand-cut letters and a five-color palette pulled from cheese, flame and chili.

Outcome

A mark that reads at a glance and works the same on a truck, a cup or a sticker.

RoleName, logo
ToolsIllustrator
Year2026
ProgramA.W. Beattie, Advertising Design
03
Hand-painted product

The Picasso slip-on

Brief

Design and paint a wearable tribute to an artist, planned panel by panel before any paint touched the shoe.

Approach

Picasso's blue period on canvas: a weeping cubist face across the toe, a blue grid on the quarter, a mosaic heel, each panel planned before painting.

Outcome

A finished pair in acrylic on canvas, painted entirely by hand.

RoleConcept, painting
MediumAcrylic on canvas
Year2026
ProgramA.W. Beattie, Advertising Design
